productTitle: One task. A clear owner, step and result.
tab1Title: One place for people and AI agents
tab1b1: The team and the agents work in one group chat.
tab1b2: Mention @sales or @accounting and that agent replies.
tab1b3: Anything waiting for you is at the top, not buried in messages.
tab2b1: The customer's own words, contact and channel are kept together.
tab2b2: A short brief marked AI is prepared for you to check.
tab2b3: Every change is added to an append-only history.
tab3Title: One owner and one next step for every customer
tab3b1: Each piece of work has exactly one accountable owner, human or agent.
tab3b2: The next step comes with a due date, so nothing floats.
tab3b3: Reassign or change the date in one click.
tab4b1: The agent prepares the message; it cannot send it on its own.
tab4b2: You approve, edit or reject before anything leaves the company.
tab4b3: The decision is recorded: proposed, reviewed, approved, logged.
tab5Title: A finished task is not yet a verified result
tab5b1: Evidence moves from pending to captured, reviewed and verified.
tab5b2: Record what happened with a reference: a note or a signed document.
tab5b3: A won deal is handed on to the Accounting Agent.
flowLead: One customer journey, from the first chat to the invoice. Humans approve everything that leaves the company.
flow1Text: Answers website visitors after hours and records the need, channel and contact.
flow2Text: Proposes the owner, next step and due date, and drafts the follow-up.
flow3Text: Approve, edit or reject. Nothing is sent before you decide.
flow4Text: Once a deal is won with evidence, the invoice is drafted and waits for your approval.
connectTitle: Start from the data you already have
connectLead: Customers reach you through several channels. NIVO starts with the one that is ready and adds the rest in order.
chWebsiteText: The Chatbot agent answers visitors and captures leads with context.
chZaloText: Customer messages become leads with an owner.
chEmailText: Customer emails are turned into tasks with a next step.
chFormText: Form submissions arrive in the same lead list.
connectNote: Only the Chatbot is available today. Other channels are on the roadmap and have no date yet.
